note: F103-FR-042. Ten drop rules of R24 F-6 and the eleventh of R29 PU-33. Thresholds are starting values with low confidence (R22:212). CQ-068 closed on 2026-09-30: the lifetime is continuation.cacheTtlSec of annex C section C.2.

reasons.rule: A new phase attempt; a critic-class call; a change of role
The previous pass was ended by a watchdog
Two consecutive passes without phase evidence and without a kept unit

The last observed context exceeds the smaller of carry.contextFillTokens and carry.contextFillShare (per cent) of the known window; a harness that reports no usage falls back to at most 2 continued passes
The time since the last request exceeds continuation.cacheTtlSec of the harness descriptor (annex C section C.2); carry.ageFallbackSec where the descriptor declares none
The model, the effort, the tool set, the plugin set or the system prompt must change
The engine was started again inside the phase attempt
A resume error, a missing transcript, or a harness upgraded between passes; announced by an event
At most carry.maxContinuedPasses continued passes in a phase attempt
The profile parity is selected (row 10 of annex X section X.7: carry.continuation off)
The first pass of the main line after a parallel group was applied

alwaysFresh: second repair of a unit of work (layer-requested)

layerRequested.rule: A fresh that a layer named in requestPass; recorded with this reason (F103-FR-042)
